name: jkrumm
title: jkrumm
description: Personal Tinycast extension — TickTick tasks, Claude usage, and Netgear Nighthawk M2 router control.
author: jkrumm

commands.name: my-tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.description: Aufgaben anzeigen und verwalten, gruppiert nach Fälligkeitsdatum

commands.name: ticktick-menu-bar
commands.title: TickTick
commands.description: Überfällige und heutige Aufgaben in der Menüleiste anzeigen

commands.name: claude-usage
commands.title: Claude Usage
commands.description: Claude quota utilization and argo spend, detailed view

commands.name: claude-usage-menu-bar
commands.title: Claude Usage
commands.description: Claude quota and spend summary in the menu bar

commands.name: netgear
commands.title: Netgear Nighthawk
commands.description: MR2100 mobile router status and actions

commands.name: netgear-watchdog
commands.title: Netgear Watchdog
commands.description: Keeps the Netgear mobile connection up: unlocks the SIM, reconnects

commands.name: battery
commands.title: Battery
commands.description: MacBook charge, health, and charge-limit control

commands.name: speed-test
commands.title: Speed Test
commands.description: networkQuality download/upload speed, latency, and data used

commands.name: van-power
commands.title: Van Power
commands.description: Camper van battery (Ective BLE BMS) and Victron solar, read over Bluetooth, with 72 h history

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token (override)
preferences.description: Bearer token for the argo proxy — leave blank to resolve it from Keychain / 1Password instead (see API Token Ref)

preferences.name: apiTokenRef
preferences.title: API Token 1Password Ref
preferences.description: op:// reference used to resolve the API Token when no override and no cached Keychain entry exist

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: argo proxy base URL (incl. /api path prefix)

preferences.name: defaultProjectId
preferences.title: Default Project ID
preferences.description: TickTick project used when Quick Add cannot match a project (optional)

preferences.name: netgearHost
preferences.title: Netgear Host
preferences.description: Base URL of the Netgear Nighthawk M2 (MR2100)

preferences.name: netgearPassword
preferences.title: Netgear Admin Password (override)
preferences.description: Router admin password — leave blank to resolve it from Keychain / 1Password instead (see Netgear Admin Password Ref)

preferences.name: netgearPasswordRef
preferences.title: Netgear Admin Password 1Password Ref
preferences.description: op:// reference used to resolve the router admin password when no override and no cached Keychain entry exist

preferences.name: victronKey
preferences.title: Victron Instant Readout Key (override)
preferences.description: 32-hex-char Instant Readout encryption key of the SmartSolar MPPT — leave blank to resolve it from Keychain / 1Password instead (see Victron Key 1Password Ref)

preferences.name: victronKeyRef
preferences.title: Victron Key 1Password Ref
preferences.description: op:// reference used to resolve the Victron key when no override and no cached Keychain entry exist
